full: Your feed said chwen read its own weights. It named a game from seventeen thousand numbers. Those seventeen thousand two hundred fifty-three parameters are a toy network, built for the test. Not the model's own twenty-seven billion parameters. Given that toy's raw weights, it named three of four games right. The full run took forty-six minutes and twelve seconds. It guessed Pac-Man on the obscure one, and the trace is almost incomprehensible. Weight reading is real: it answered questions about numbers handed to it, the toy's raw weights. It never once looked inward. The prompts are waiting in RikiyaT's repo. Your laptop can read real weights tonight.
